snippets.snippet: City of Parma Heights 6281 Pearl Road• Parma Heights, Ohio 44130 440.884.9607 • building@parmaheightsoh.gov Dear New Business Owner, Welcome to the City of Parma Heights! As a new business owner or new owner of an existing business, we wanted to share with you the required licensing and permit procedures. Whenever there is a change in ownership, the new business owner must obtain a New Occupancy Permit and a New Commercial License, as required by Parma Heights Codified Ordinance. Both documents are non - transferrable. Below are the steps you need to take: □ Letter of Intent - Send a letter of intent to Service Director Robert Sepik via mail (6281 Pearl Road, Parma Heights, OH 44130} or email (rsepik@parmaheights.us} .
